packageRules.description: Group minor and patch updates of development tools at 1.0 or later; pre-1.0 updates and Playwright get separate pull requests.
Group minor and patch updates of Rust crates at 1.0 or later; pre-1.0 updates get separate pull requests. The later Tauri rule keeps its packages together.
The Tauri CLI refuses to build when an npm package and its Rust crate differ in major or minor version, so they update in one pull request.
Actions stay pinned to a full commit SHA with the version in a comment.
@types/node follows the Node.js major in .node-version and is raised by hand with it.
Node.js and pnpm majors also change NODE_VERSION or PNPM_VERSION in wrangler.toml, and @types/node for Node.js, by hand, so their pull requests open only when approved on the Dependency Dashboard.
